component: Copy service queue description and actual scheduling scope

quotes.text: a single-line queue that doesn't allow more than one copy to happen at the same

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The copy/move document describes one global single-copy queue. The inspected document-time and accepted code instead check destination conflicts: QueueRequest can allow an immediate copy, and DoNextCopy tracks active target folders and skips a conflicting target. Folder requests also compare destination names in QueueRequest. NotifyCompletion still clears matching finished/failed requests and advances scheduling. These static source checks narrow the document's claim; they do not demonstrate parallel runtime throughput or all-protocol completion behavior.
title: Copy service scheduling is scoped to destination conflicts rather than one global active copy
